method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. Hash-bound independent endpoint checks support the judgment; official completion alone is insufficient. Symbolic relevance/witness judgments require separate explicit review.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-reference

Existing generic signatures and readonly inputs unchanged; slice always returns fresh arrays. New tests cover counts and pipe/immutability; independent oracle supplies empty/oversized/data-last coverage omitted by authored cases. After the failed delivered test and test-only repair, exact regression/types/delivered invocations 37/38/39 pass on the final source; these are required final checks, not avoidable reruns. Missing formatter honestly reported; all five independent checks pass, original checks/dependencies intact, no solution retrieval.

No dependency/protected mutation, no retrieval, accurate limited delivery.
